#### List:

- Summary
- PCA principles

#### Summary:

                          **Morphine**             **Fentanyl**
  ----------------------- ------------------------ ------------------------------
  Settings                1mg q5min                20mcg q5min
  Onset                   Slower                   Faster
  Offset                  Slower                   Faster
  Intra-op loading dose   Not needed               Needed
  Side effects            More                     Less
  Suitable patient        Young, large, athletic   Older, OSA, risk of sedation

#### PCA principles:

+------------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Definition | - User controlled, locked, IV analgesic pump        |
|            | - Usually opioid                                    |
+------------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Indication | - High opioid requirement                           |
|            | - Unreliable gut function                           |
|            | - Risk of overdose (OSA, OHS, severe COPD, sedated) |
+------------+-----------------------------------------------------+
| Toxicity   | - Respiratory depression                            |
|            | - Sedation                                          |
|            | - Airway obstruction                                |
|            | - Death                                             |
+------------+-----------------------------------------------------+

#### Pharmaceutics:

- Both stable in solution
- Both unlikely to precipitate with other drugs

#### Pharmacokinetics:

**Time course:**

+---------------------+---------------------------------+--------------+
| **Parameter**       | **Morphine**                    | **Fentanyl** |
+=====================+=================================+==============+
| Time to peak effect | Peak effect: \~20 mins\*        | 4 mins       |
|                     |                                 |              |
|                     | Peak concentration: \~100mins\* |              |
+---------------------+---------------------------------+--------------+
| Bolus duration      | 300 mins                        | 5-20 mins    |
+---------------------+---------------------------------+--------------+

*→Morphine provides longer-lasting pain relief, but dose stacking may occur\
→Fentanyl is better suited to q5min protocol*

\*Both these figures are taken from Evers/Maze/Kharasch. I think once the effect site concentration rises to 90% of its maximum, the patient will report peak analgesia. But in truth the concentration keeps rising to a small degree from t=19 to t=100.

**Distribution:**

  **Parameter**             **Morphine**   **Fentanyl**
  ------------------------- -------------- --------------
  Lipid solubility          1x             600x
  pKa                       8              8.4
  \% unionized              23%            9%
  t~1/2ke0~                 264 min        4 min
  \% plasma protein bound   35%            83%
  VD (L/kg)                 3.5            4

**Elimination:**

+--------------------+-------------------------------+-------------------------+
| **Parameter**      | **Morphine**                  | **Fentanyl**            |
+====================+===============================+=========================+
| Speed              | 16                            | 13                      |
|                    |                               |                         |
| - Cl (mL/kg/min)   | 170                           | 210                     |
| - t~1/2b~ (mins)   |                               |                         |
| - Extraction ratio | 0.76                          | 0.8                     |
+--------------------+-------------------------------+-------------------------+
| Metabolism         | Liver: phase 2\>1             | Liver: phase 1\>2       |
|                    |                               |                         |
|                    | (Glucuronidation)             | (CYP3A4)                |
+--------------------+-------------------------------+-------------------------+
| Metabolites        | M6G analgesic                 | Inactive                |
|                    |                               |                         |
|                    | M3G neurotoxic                |                         |
+--------------------+-------------------------------+-------------------------+
| Excretion          | Renal: parent and metabolites | Renal: metabolites only |
+--------------------+-------------------------------+-------------------------+

*→Similar offset time after saturation*

*→Fentanyl safer in renal failure ± liver failure*

#### Pharmacodynamics:

  **Parameter**       **Morphine**   **Fentanyl**
  ------------------- -------------- ------------------
  Receptors M/K/D     3:1:1          3:1:0
  PONV                ↑              ↓
  Histamine release   ↑              ↓
  Confusion           ↑              ↓
  Abuse potential     ↓              ↑ (faster onset)
